data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'nuh' which means 'rest' or 'repose'. It is also related to the story of Prophet Noah in the Quran, who was a righteous man who sought refuge from God during a time of great turmoil and flood. The name Nuhuz carries the meaning “Rest, repose, peace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Nuhuz usually hope their child will grow to embody rest, repose, peace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
